content: Obo kw'Abraham.
Wa Abraham okwu ọtzọkha kwanọng ọdọdọk kw'okpen Kẹtura.
Kẹ wọ ọmaan-ẹ Zimran, ọmaana Jọkshan, ọmaana Medan, ọmaana Midiyan, ọmaana Ishbak ttara Shua.
Jọkshan wa ode otte kwa Sheba ọmaana Dedan; va pa va pa Dedan ade abAshur, ọmaana abaLẹtush, ttara abaLeum.
Va p'ijinọng pa Midiyan ade Ẹpha, ọmaana Ẹphẹr, ọmaana Hanọk, ọmaana Abida, ttara Ẹlda. Va mba biphyir wa bẹ ade va pa va pa Kẹtura.
Wa Isaak ọtzọk ekkema k'ẹkhakhaama chẹ biphyir ch'Abraham ope oji.
Yina, Abraham ọn-ọbhaangi va mbonggo pẹ biphyir, p'akkọra-panọng oruk, ttara ekpo pyẹ ẹdọdọk, oben bẹ akhọm aruk achina k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin, abhir Isaak eden.
Biphyir-phyir wa Abraham orukhi cho arọbh azenanttaan obhiri chi.
Mẹ wọ, wa Abraham oji ikponga-nnam-wọhng sẹ, ope k'atzam, bẹ anọhng-ẹ otzor anọng pẹ p'akk'apa.
Wa nnwa kwẹ Isaak ọmaana Ishimayẹl, anọhnga otte kwabẹ, k'ọmma kw'itzakpa kw'owobh ka Makpẹla, ọbaanga Mamrẹ, k'irerek s'iwa ide s'Ẹphrọn, kw'ode nnwa kwa Zoha kw'ofon Het.
Wa Abraham odebhi irerek nna ka mbọhk s'anọng pa Het. Wa bẹ anọhnga Abraham m'ibe nna rani s'iwa bẹ anọhng kwanọng kwẹ, Sara.
Mada Abraham ọkk'ọpa, Ibinọkpaabyi odo nnwa kwẹ Isaak, kw'iwa on-orukhi ọbaanga Beer-Lahai-Roi.
Efona ch'Ishimayẹl
Ma wọ ode efonamma ch'Ishimayẹl, kw'ode nnwa kw'Abraham obhoni ka ndaak sa Hagar kw'ofon Ijip, kw'iwa ode obira kwa Sara.
Ma wọ ode che pa va p'Ishimayẹl k'odem kw'obhoni bẹ: Nẹbayọt kw'ode ocheden-nwa, ọmaana Kẹda, ọmaana Adbẹl, ọmaana Mibsam,
ọmaana Mishma, ọmaana Duma, ọmaana Masa,
ọmaana Hadad, ọmaana Tẹma, ọmaana Jetur, ọmaana Naphish, ttara Kẹdẹma.
Ma wọ iwa ode va p'ijinọng p'Ishimayẹl p'adabhi ngọma jobh obhiri mfa, sa mkpen che mmina bẹ, atzor k'aruk pabẹ ọmaana k'obhingabe fabẹ.
Biphyir-phyir wa Ishimayẹl orukhi cho arọbh azadani obhiri chi obhiri afa, ope, bẹ anọhng-ẹ otzor anọng pẹ p'akk'apa.
Wa va pa va pẹ arukhi ttẹwọr k'okhubha kwa Havila maa, apyiri k'okhuba kwa Shur, kw'owobh ọbaanga k'enem ch'Ijip, kẹ da achin k'okhubha kw'Ashur. Wa bẹ arukhi k'ittattaanga ttara votte pabẹ biphyir.
Ẹmmaana ch'Ẹsau ọmaana Jekọb
Ma wọ ode efonamma ch'Isaak, kw'ode nnwa kw'Abraham. Abraham wọ iwa obhoni Isaak.
Iwa Isaak ode cho arọbh afa, k'ogbe kw'ọtzọk Rẹbẹka k'ọbada. Rẹbẹka ode nnwa kwa Bẹtuẹl kw'ofon Aram, kwa Padan-Aram, obiro ode ọgbaanọkka kwa Laban kw'ofon Aram.
Wa Rẹbẹka ọkpaan-ọkpaana, mẹ wọ, Isaak ozi njọhm ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'eho chẹ. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga njọhm sẹ, osi Rẹbẹka otzima ibhọr.
Wa va afa p'awobh-ẹ k'ẹbhọr am-arima ayok abẹ. Mẹ wọ, Rẹbẹka ọbọbh bi, “Bọng odik wọ om-okhebh-m ma o?” Mando kw'orori odik nwa ọbọbh Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obhin-ẹ bi,

content.text: ngọma nna mfa s'iwobh-ọ m'ẹbhọr, ikhina sẹ ḿmaangi ayok,
ẹkhọma dani ẹ́khaama ẹfa ẹyọhnga oyok.
Ẹkhọma ch'echi eden ẹmmaana, ési ọtzọhm ẹnang ẹkhọma ch'ekpong nnam.”

content: Mada ogbe opyiri kw'ọmaan, va p'ijinọng afa bọ awobh-ẹ k'ẹbhọr.
Nnwa kw'ochi eden oyin okhor-okhor, ttara iphyubha ka for mach'ẹnọhmakpa ch'ede iphyubha-iphyubha. Mẹ wọ, bẹ akpẹ-ẹ Ẹsau.
Mada ocheden okk'oyina, ọgbaanọkka obiro oyin, ọbọkha Ẹsau k'ibhokhọkhọri. Mẹ wọ, bẹ an-akpẹ-ẹ Jekọb. Wa Isaak on-ode cho arọbh attaan, k'ogbe kwa Rẹbẹka ọmaani va mba.
Mada va mba akk'abara, Ẹsau okwu ode ọgbaajijaa kw'ideden, obiro ode ọnọng kw'orukhi k'ọyaankpa. Yina, Jekọb kẹ ode ọnọng kw'odiri akpen, kw'om-okwora k'ẹttọhmma.
Wa Isaak kẹ ọdaakhi ẹgbatzen ochichi, ofona mẹ, Ẹsau kw'ode ọgbaajijaa ọdaakh-ẹ idik. Yina, wa Jekọb wọ ọdaakhi Rẹbẹka.
K'ogbe wani kw'iwa Jekọb ọm-ọwọhn ọchattọhk, Ẹsau ofona k'ẹgbaaji okhuna, ttara okwo f'ọkk'ẹ ọkhaama maa, for imọm-ẹ.
Mẹ wọ, oben Jekọb bi, “Kebh-m ẹbọhnga nduma ch'ekhor-okhor nchi ẹbhar-ẹbhar, kkeri ẹfa ẹkk'aam ẹha itzam-itzama!” (Mẹ wọ ofon bẹ am-ayer-ẹ Edom
Jekọb obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ chi eden anang-m ededen chọ ch'ocheden-nwa.”
Ẹsau on-obhin-ẹ bi, “Bọng ejibha ch'ededen ẹnang-m o, kwa kaam nwobha ma, okwo ofhu-m o?”
Yina, Jekọb oben bi, “Kọ chi eden chekhi bi, anang-m ededen chọ ọnang.” Mẹ wọ, Ẹsau ọtzọkha ọnwọhngi kw'ọnangi Jekọb ededen chẹ.
Mando kwa Jekọb ọtzọk brẹd ọttara k'ẹbọhnga ch'achen-meni ọnang Ẹsau, Ẹsau ochi obiro ọttaakhi ẹbọhnga, obina ofona. Mando wọ kw'iwa Ẹsau oreng olukhi ededen chẹ ch'ocheden-nwa.
